svg.title: MLOps Pipeline Diagram
svg.desc: Shows how CI, CT, Security, and ArgoCD CD workflows connect in a GitHub Actions MLOps pipeline

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What branches trigger the CI and Security workflows?')
sendPrompt('What does the monthly schedule trigger?')
sendPrompt('What path triggers the Continuous Training pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What linting tools are used in the CI pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How are unit tests run in CI and what coverage tool is used?')
sendPrompt('What does the Build step in CI do?')
sendPrompt('What tools scan for secrets in the security pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does CodeQL analyse in the security workflow?')
sendPrompt('How are Python dependencies audited for vulnerabilities?')
sendPrompt('What code quality tools run in the security workflow?')
sendPrompt('What Docker image scanners are used in the security pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the security summary job report?')
sendPrompt('What does the CT pipeline run first?')
sendPrompt('What does the training pipeline execute?')
sendPrompt('What artifacts are committed after CT retraining?')
sendPrompt('What condition must be met for ArgoCD sync to trigger?')
sendPrompt('How does ArgoCD log in during the sync workflow?')
sendPrompt('What application does ArgoCD sync?')
sendPrompt('What does the ArgoCD health wait do?')
sendPrompt('Where is the ML app deployed after ArgoCD syncs?')
